mapper.select: select ppl.problem_id as problem_id, p.title as title, ppl.score as score, sum(IF(status = 1, 1, 0)) as right_num, sum(IF(status = 0, 1, 0)) as wrong_num, avg(r.score) as average from problem_problem_list ppl left join contest c on c.list_id = ppl.list_id and c.del_flag = 0 left join contest_records r on r.problem_id = ppl.problem_id and r.contest_id = #{contestId} left join problem p on p.problem_id = ppl.problem_id where c.contest_id = #{contestId} and p.del_flag = 0 group by ppl.problem_id

select uc.user_id as user_id, (select count(*) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id and cr.status = 1) as right_num, (select count(*) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id and cr.status = 0) as wrong_num, (select count(*) - right_num - wrong_num from problem_problem_list ppl left join contest c on c.list_id = ppl.list_id where c.contest_id = #{contestId}) as absent_num, (select sum(cr.score) from contest_records cr where cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = uc.user_id) as score, IF(ISNULL(ub.user_id), 0, 1) as submitted, IF(ISNULL(ub.submit_time), 0, ub.submit_time > c.end_time) as late
from user_contest uc left join contest c on c.contest_id = uc.contest_id left join user_submit ub on ub.contest_id = uc.contest_id and ub.user_id = uc.user_id where uc.contest_id = #{contestId}

select ppl.problem_id as problemId, p.title as title, cr.status as correct, cr.score as score from problem_problem_list ppl left join problem p on ppl.problem_id = p.problem_id left join contest_records cr on p.problem_id = cr.problem_id and cr.contest_id = #{contestId} and cr.user_id = #{userId} where p.del_flag = 0
